Accelerated Mobility.name: Accelerated Mobility
Accelerated Mobility.description: Actuated legs, efficient gears in the wheels or treads, or add-on boosters make tu construct faster. Tu innovation's Velocidad increases to 40 pies.

Advanced Weaponry.name: Advanced Weaponry
Advanced Weaponry.description:
Has powered up tu construct's weaponry. Elige one of tu construct's ataques sin armas to gain tu choice of one initial arma modification, chosen from the list on page 18 or from other initial arma modifications to which tienes access. The ataque sin armas must meet any requirements for the chosen rasgos (such as being a melee attack for entangling form), and since it's an ataque sin armas, it can never meet certain requirements, such as being a simple arma for complex simplicity.

Note: Weapon Modifications are not in this module or the system currently, the strike rule elements on the appropriate feature can be modified to apply the modifications.

Amphibious Construct.name: Amphibious Construct
Amphibious Construct.description: Increased buoyancy, rudders, and a means of propulsion like a fluked tail or powerful propeller make tu construct able to travel in water. Tu innovation gains a swim Velocidad of 25 pies.

Antimagic Construction.name: Antimagic Construction
Antimagic Construction.description: Whether you used some clever adaptation of the magic-negating skymetal known as noqual or created magical protections entirely of tu own devising, has made tu innovation highly resilient to conjuros. Tu construct innovation gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to all tiradas de salvación and AC against conjuros.

Climbing Limbs.name: Climbing Limbs
Climbing Limbs.description: With appendages that can claw or create suction, tu construct becomes a capable climber. Tu innovation gains a climb Velocidad equal to half its land Velocidad.

Durable Construction.name: Durable Construction
Durable Construction.description: Tu innovation is solidly built; it can take significant punishment before being destroyed. Increase its maximum HP by tu level.

Flight Chassis.name: Flight Chassis
Flight Chassis.description: Tú fit tu construct with a means of flight, such as adding rotors or rebuilding it with wings and a lightweight construction. Tu innovation gains a fly Velocidad of 25 pies.

Increased Size.name: Increased Size
Increased Size.description: Tú built tu construct innovation bigger than most. Tu construct is Large. If tienes this modification and tu construct innovation becomes an advanced construct companion or otherwise gains the ability to become Large, puedes immediately change increased size to a different initial construct modification.

Manual Dexterity.name: Manual Dexterity
Manual Dexterity.description: Tu construct innovation has articulated hands or similar appendages with significant manual dexterity. It can perform manipulate actions with up to two of its limbs. As normal for a companion, it still can't wield armas or held items that don't have the companion rasgo, and it can't activate items.

Marvelous Gears.name: Marvelous Gears
Marvelous Gears.description: Tu innovation gains expert proficiency in Intimidation, Stealth, and Survival. For any of these skills in which it was already an expert (because of being an advanced construct companion, for example), it gains master proficiency instead. If tienes the revolutionary innovation class feature, these proficiencies improve to master, or legendary if tu construct innovation was already an expert. Debes have the wonder gears modification to select this modification.

Miracle Gears.name: Miracle Gears
Miracle Gears.description: As you perfect tu innovation's cortex, it becomes much more intelligent. Its Intelligence modifier increases by 2, and it learns a language of tu choice from among the languages you know. Tu construct gains the ability to use actions that require greater Intelligence, like @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.Coerce]{Coerce} and @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing}. Finally, tu construct becomes legendary in two Intelligence- or Charisma-based skills of tu choice. Debes have the marvelous gears modification to select this modification.

Projectile Launcher.name: Projectile Launcher
Projectile Launcher.description: Tu construct has a mounted dart launcher, embedded cannon, or similar armament. Tu innovation gains a ranged ataque sin armas that deals 1d4 bludgeoning or daño perforante (you elige when you pick this modification). The attack has the propulsive rasgo and a range increment of 30 pies.

Resistant Coating.name: Resistant Coating
Resistant Coating.description: Tu innovation is hard to daño by any means. It gains resistance 5 to all daño (except adamantine).

Runic Keystone.name: Runic Keystone
Runic Keystone.description:
Has incorporated a device similar to a runestone into tu innovation, allowing it to hold a property rune, even though it isn't a arma or suit of armor. An armor property rune affects tu innovation itself if it would affect the wearer of the armor. A arma property rune grants whatever properties it would normally grant to a arma to tu innovation's ataques sin armas, following all the requirements as normal (for instance, a vorpal rune would only apply to slashing melee ataques sin armas); if the rune affects only ranged attacks, it has no effect unless tu innovation has a built-in ranged attack (from the projectile launcher initial modification, for example). If the rune would affect the physical shape or appearance of the arma or armor itself, like glamered, the rune has no effect when etched into tu construct.

Note: This is left without automation until system rune improvements are completed.

Sensory Array.name: Sensory Array
Sensory Array.description: Additional sensory devices give tu innovation low-light vision and darkvision, as well as imprecise tremorsense out to a range of 30 pies.

Turret Configuration.name: Turret Configuration
Turret Configuration.description:
Tu innovation can transform from a mobile construct to a stationary turret. Tu construct companion can transform as a single action, which has the manipulate rasgo, turning into a turret in its space (or transforming back from a turret into its normal configuration). While it's a turret, tu innovation is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.Immobilized]{Immobilized}, but the dado de daño from its projectile launcher increases to 1d6 and the range increment increases to 60 pies. Debes have the projectile launcher modification to select this modification.

Note: If you renamed the Projectile Launcher breakthrough you will need to modify the rule element selector on this to the new name.

Wall Configuration.name: Wall Configuration
Wall Configuration.description: Tu innovation can transform from a mobile construct to a stationary battlefield emplacement. It can unfold as a 2-action activity that has the manipulate rasgo, changing from its usual form into a thin, straight wall of metal and gears up to 10 pies tall and 30 pies long. The wall must extend through tu innovation's original space. While tu construct is a wall, it can't take any actions except to use the same activity to transform back, and it can't defend itself easily, making it @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.Desprevenido]{Desprevenido} and giving it an additional -2 penalización de estado to its AC. The wall blocks line of sight and effect unless tu innovation has half its maximum HP or fewer, at which point holes in the wall allow creatures to see through and attack with cover, and Tiny creatures to slip through.

Wonder Gears.name: Wonder Gears
Wonder Gears.description: Tú map specialized skills into tu construct's crude intelligence. Tu innovation becomes entrenado in Intimidation, Stealth, and Survival.
